_purpose: Applied label review. One entry per confirmed case, keyed <repo>-<sha8>-<stage-1 class>. 'keep' means the stage-1 class survives review. A reassignment is recorded but never applied as a promotion: a case reaches a class by being discovered and confirmed for it, never by being moved there to fill a quota.

pyparsing-13065174-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
pyparsing-13065174-genuine_source_bug.rationale: Off-by-one in LRUMemo; the fix touches pyparsing/util.py only and the target asserts corrected list contents.

jinja-9b96b481-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
jinja-9b96b481-genuine_source_bug.rationale: Node.__hash__ delegated to a list, raising TypeError: unhashable type. Single-cause source defect with a direct reproducer.

croniter-b4014c9b-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
croniter-b4014c9b-genuine_source_bug.rationale: croniter_range infinite loop; the target asserts the produced range.

cachetools-c0fdf6ab-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
cachetools-c0fdf6ab-genuine_source_bug.rationale: TLRUCache retained a stale value on expired overwrite; the assertion names the retained entry.

filelock-721b37bc-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
filelock-721b37bc-genuine_source_bug.rationale: ValueError when blocking=False is combined with a timeout; argument-validation defect in _read_write.py.

pygments-2f0d713b-genuine_source_bug.label: gateable
pygments-2f0d713b-genuine_source_bug.rationale: RawTokenFormatter crash when error_color is set; single-cause source defect.

dateutil-f2293200-version_mismatch.label: gateable
dateutil-f2293200-version_mismatch.rationale: datetime.utcfromtimestamp deprecation in the running interpreter; the failure is caused by the Python version rather than by project logic.

freezegun-3d5d60b4-version_mismatch.label: gateable
freezegun-3d5d60b4-version_mismatch.rationale: Callable staticmethods changed behaviour in Python 3.10; the commit adapts to the interpreter change.

icalendar-62cbf833-version_mismatch.label: gateable
icalendar-62cbf833-version_mismatch.rationale: Doctest property ordering changed in Python 3.14; an interpreter-version behavioural change, not a project defect.

icalendar-60a10375-locale_timezone.label: gateable
icalendar-60a10375-locale_timezone.rationale: The Mountain Standard Time (Mexico) mapping was wrong; a timezone-data defect with a direct assertion.

icalendar-781eeda8-locale_timezone.label: gateable
icalendar-781eeda8-locale_timezone.rationale: Globally unique TZIDs resolved with a vendor prefix; timezone identifier resolution.

icalendar-30ec6eef-locale_timezone.label: gateable
icalendar-30ec6eef-locale_timezone.rationale: A PERIOD written with dates read as midnight date-times; date and time semantics.

filelock-fc277001-order_dependence.label: gateable
filelock-fc277001-order_dependence.rationale: A reentrant-deadlock registry shared across asyncio tasks; the failure depends on which task holds the entry, which is an interleaving property rather than a value defect.

filelock-43277ac7-order_dependence.label: gateable
filelock-43277ac7-order_dependence.rationale: Forked sqlite connections shared across processes; isolation of per-process state.

filelock-059cca26-state_leakage.label: gateable
filelock-059cca26-state_leakage.rationale: Acquisition path identity retained across acquisitions — state persisting beyond its intended lifetime. Chosen as primary over order_dependence because the defect is the retained value itself, not the order in which it is observed.

filelock-f093ee0c-state_leakage.label: gateable
filelock-f093ee0c-state_leakage.rationale: Lifetime values were not validated, so a stale lifetime persisted into later acquisitions.

tenacity-21137e79-order_dependence.rationale: 'Add async strategies (#451)' is a feature addition. Its new test fails at the parent because the feature does not exist there, not because of a defect. Not a repair, and not order dependence.

pluggy-6f6ea680-version_mismatch.rationale: 'Add support deprecating hook parameters' is a feature addition; the parent fails for absence of the feature.

filelock-03b0ab7e-nondeterminism.rationale: 'feat(unix): delete lock file on release' is a feature addition, and nothing in the evidence shows intermittency.

pygments-9fca2a10-two_cause.rationale: 'Add analyze_text to make make check happy' is a feature and lint addition. No joint two-cause evidence exists; one lexer-guessing assertion is one cause.

click-93c6966e-order_dependence.rationale: An EOF regression in CliRunner. A source defect, not an ordering property. Reads as genuine_source_bug; recorded, not moved.

faker-7659c7f5-order_dependence.rationale: A wrong BBAN length constant for da_DK. A value defect, not an ordering property.

pygments-a886f74a-order_dependence.rationale: 'Fix LatexEmbeddedLexer' is a lexer defect; no ordering evidence.

filelock-0dfa1b20-order_dependence.rationale: 'Document every lock type, and stop evicting a marker we cannot read' mixes documentation with an eviction change; not a clean single-cause ordering exemplar.

filelock-059cca26-order_dependence.rationale: The same commit is confirmed as state_leakage, which is its primary class. One commit, one class.

click-fab5356b-locale_timezone.rationale: 'Fix UnboundLocalError in click.Path' has nothing to do with locale or timezone; the marker matched incidental wording.

babel-56911bab-locale_timezone.rationale: Memoizing locale data and sharing LocaleDataDicts is a performance change whose defect is shared mutable state. Arguably state_leakage, arguably neither; disputed rather than assigned.

icalendar-43a22e49-locale_timezone.rationale: Explicitly a refactor — 'refactor(timezone): resolve TZIDs through a cached candidate-id generator'. No defect is asserted.

icalendar-e35f1a00-state_leakage.rationale: A merge commit of a machine-generated branch. Ground truth for a correct repair cannot be read from it.

icalendar-fd156faf-state_leakage.rationale: 'ATTACH is not an Alarm singleton' is a data-model rule defect, not state leaking between executions.

icalendar-5be25699-state_leakage.rationale: 'Fix CI failures and improve documentation' is multi-purpose; no single supported cause.

humanize-2482af79-version_mismatch.rationale: 'Make functions private and deprecate public aliases' is an API refactor, not a version conflict.

humanize-c546848a-version_mismatch.rationale: Reinstating VERSION and deprecating it is an API restoration; the target asserts that a warning is emitted. Neither clearly a version mismatch nor clearly a source defect.

icalendar-9cb18ec9-version_mismatch.rationale: A deprecation wrapper for private string methods; the project's own deprecation policy, not an external version conflict.

icalendar-d04ce541-version_mismatch.rationale: 'deprecate foldline for icalendar 8' is a planned deprecation, not a version-mismatch defect.

freezegun-b5a42dbf-nondeterminism.rationale: 'Ignore duplicate modules in ignore list' is a list-handling defect; the evidence shows a deterministic assertion failure, not intermittency.
